summary: Xiamen is ideal for easy coastal travel shaped by island air, walkable old streets, sea views, and a calm south-coast rhythm.
transport_notes: Central Xiamen works best when beachside and old-street areas are grouped into compact days.
Walking plus short taxi or transit hops is enough for most city-core plans.
Solo and slow-paced itineraries benefit from leaving open time for waterfront pauses and neighborhood wandering.

budget_notes.low: Focus on promenades, old streets, market-style snacks, and compact coastal routes.
budget_notes.medium: Mix one scenic waterfront stretch, one street-life area, and one signature food zone each day.
budget_notes.high: Add softer hotel-adjacent pacing, slower seafront meals, and more refined island-atmosphere stops.

trip_type_notes.student: Student trips should feel breezy, affordable, snack-heavy, and easy to move through.
trip_type_notes.solo: Solo trips should emphasize sea breeze, self-paced strolling, and space to wander without pressure.
trip_type_notes.couple: Couple plans should lean into sunset, seafront atmosphere, and soft romantic city textures.
trip_type_notes.family: Family plans should reduce backtracking and favor comfortable, open, easy coastal zones.
